Join activities to assays, target dictionary, molecule dictionary, and compound structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1250402, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return the first 1000 rows sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
